observations.code_quote: Scouts write them via `charts` on `emit_report` / `edit_report`. On an edit `charts` is the report's whole set — it replaces what was there, the way `summary` replaces the summary, and omitting it leaves the existing charts alone. On the emit path the safety judge sees a report's chart titles, captions, and queries alongside its prose, so an injected chart is suppressed with the report. The edit path judges nothing today — not title, summary, notes, reviewers, or charts — so a chart set by a later edit reaches the reader unscreened, exactly as an edited summary does.
